mission.foundation: Barrot V3 remains execution, orchestration, safety and verification foundation

current_main.explanation: The two intervening changes are generated paid-issue data files. Main ci.yml ignores both paths. No application/workflow source code changed in that commit.

workflow_security_review.scope: All 68 changed workflow patches were enumerated and scanned for triggers, permissions, secrets, external actions, deployments, writes, and manual confirmations. Full-file review was performed on 18 higher-risk workflows. This is a bounded static review, not a completed transitive audit of every invoked script, artifact, action, and data flow.
positive_controls: Legacy autonomous worker/merge/agent workflows are quarantined with permissions {} and if false.
Core actions including checkout, setup-python, upload-artifact, download-artifact, Jekyll, Cloudflare Wrangler, and Databricks CLI are pinned to full commit SHAs in the reviewed changes.
External operations generally require workflow_dispatch, explicit YES inputs, main-branch execution, and exact approved-main-SHA checks.
The XRP ingestion workflow has contents:read and actions:read, persist-credentials:false, and no repository write permission.

blockers_and_warnings.finding: Databricks workspace import uses --overwrite on /Shared/barrot_databricks_job. It requires confirm_external_change=YES, confirm_databricks_workspace_import=YES, and an exact source SHA matching current main, but has no target backup or target-state hash/CAS guard.
blockers_and_warnings.disposition: Do not dispatch. Add a target backup and non-destructive create-or-compare policy before treating this path as merge-safe.

blockers_and_warnings.finding: Manual artifact-only paper simulation for BTC-USD; requires confirm=YES and exact main SHA. No paper trade was run.
blockers_and_warnings.disposition: Do not dispatch without specific approval for the exact simulation, product, SHA, scope, and run.

blockers_and_warnings.finding: Cloudflare Worker deployment and secret upload require confirm=YES, confirm_secret_rotation=YES, and exact main SHA.
blockers_and_warnings.disposition: No deployment or secret rotation was performed.

blockers_and_warnings.finding: User-supplied requirements and constraints are sent to Groq after YES confirmation and exact-main-SHA validation. The workflow relies on operator-provided public/authorized-data classification and does not perform automated redaction.
blockers_and_warnings.disposition: No external-model dispatch. Require explicit data classification and redaction before use.

blockers_and_warnings.finding: Main still has a workflow_run publisher with contents:write that commits only PAID-ISSUES.md and data/money/paid_issues.json after checking mutations_performed==0. Integration disables this publisher.
blockers_and_warnings.disposition: No write or deployment was initiated by this run; automatic main data commits remain an external workflow side effect.

blockers_and_warnings.finding: The workflow is absent from main (main contents API returns 404). Its hourly and daily schedules therefore are not active on main. The integration push/manual paths are read-only.
blockers_and_warnings.disposition: Scheduled ingestion is not yet active in production.

executed_components: Read-only public XRP ingestion adapters for spot tickers, order-book depth, derivatives, XRPL node information, ETF issuer pages, exchange-wallet observations, RLUSD/Circle transparency, SBI VC Trade, Morpho cbXRP markets, Coinbase cbXRP proof-of-reserves, SEC filings and CFTC reports.
Content-addressed RawReceiptArchive with SHA-256 receipts and local receipt-chain verification.
SQLite point-in-time feature store with receipt-time availability, source lineage and ordinary application-level mutation deterrence.
Chronological walk-forward evaluator with naive class-prior, momentum-sign, mean-reversion-sign and volatility-normal baselines.
Forecast ledger with fixed horizons, outcome resolution, calibration, source independence and independent Ed25519 readiness-attestation checks.
Event timeline and counter-hypothesis support with explicit known-at, capture-at and event-time separation.
Feature drift diagnostic; diagnostic status cannot authorize forecasts.
limitations: The local receipt chain is not an independently controlled WORM or trusted timestamp anchor.
GitHub Actions raw artifacts have 90-day retention; the per-run feature-store checkpoint has 7-day retention and the daily archive 90 days.
SQLite triggers and unkeyed local hashes are not adversarially tamper-proof.
The scheduled workflow is not present on main, so scheduled production ingestion is not active.

The last ingestion counts recorded in the previous handoff remain 34 receipts (22 raw, 12 digest-only), 21 source failures, 3,235 feature-history records, 140 events, 107 scenarios, and zero walk-forward forecasts; no newer successful ingestion artifact was verified in this run.

Their official profiles call the other two sister companies. They are not SBI Holdings, Inc.; no primary source reviewed identifies them as SBI Holdings subsidiaries or operating units.

chatgpt_evidence.finding: Tokyo SBIC hosted a public free seminar on 2025-02-26 titled 'The Present and Future of Generative AI (ChatGPT)'. The announced speaker was a Microsoft Japan executive/evangelist, and the program included ChatGPT demonstration. Tokyo SBIC also ran an investee-company manufacturing AI/ML training on 2025-06-12 to 2025-06-13 with ChatGPT use and Copilot curriculum. Osaka SBIC ran a generative-AI workshop for investee executives on 2025-12-15 and an AI-agent seminar on 2026-01-29.
chatgpt_evidence.interpretation: Evidence of SBIC educational programming and training, not an OpenAI partnership, corporate affiliation, product integration, or ChatGPT-SBIC data-sharing agreement.

sbic_identity.law_finding: The Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Company Law, Article 2, explicitly names exactly three companies: Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka, each with its own head office in the corresponding city. The law was enacted 1963-06-10.

sbi_ripple.ownership: SBI Group 60%; Ripple 40% of SBI Ripple Asia, per SBI's FY2024 results presentation dated 2025-05-09.
sbi_ripple.ripple_equity: SBI Holdings' official 2025-06-09 release says SBI Group held approximately 9% of Ripple as its largest external shareholder at that time. This is a dated company disclosure, not a verified November 2026 cap-table snapshot.
sbi_ripple.operating_rail: SBI Remit began an international remittance service using XRP as a bridge currency in 2021. No verified corridor-level throughput or XRP inventory data was obtained in this run.
sbi_ripple.rlusd_japan: SBI VC Trade, a consolidated subsidiary of SBI Holdings, agreed with Ripple subsidiary Standard Custody & Trust Company in 2025 to support Japanese RLUSD issuance/distribution; SBI VC Trade began RLUSD handling on 2026-06-24.
sbi_ripple.xrpl_projects: SBI Ripple Asia's 2026-02-26 tokenized-deposit/deposit-money POC and 2026-02-24 Japan-Korea remittance study contemplate XRPL use; neither is proof of a live production bank deployment.

sbi_circle.ownership: SBI Holdings and Circle agreed a 50/50 Japan stablecoin JV; the SBI Circle Holdings company was established in 2025.
sbi_circle.equity: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank acquired $50 million of Circle shares at Circle's 2025 IPO, $25 million each.
sbi_circle.usdc_distribution: SBI VC Trade launched public USDC trading in Japan in March 2025; SBI's 2026-05-12 release confirms the JV was established and describes the ongoing relationship.
sbi_circle.arc_investment: SBI Holdings participated in Circle's ARC Token presale in 2026-05. Arc is Circle's separate L1 initiative, not XRPL.
sbi_circle.arc_validator: Circle's 2026-09-16 Arc mainnet announcement identifies SBI Group as a founding validator and says SBI intends to use USDC and JPYSC, a trust-type yen stablecoin issued by SBI Shinsei Trust. Arc uses USDC for gas fees; this is a separate Circle L1, not XRPL.

coinbase_circle.relationship: Circle remains USDC issuer. Coinbase and Circle's 2023 agreement includes Coinbase equity participation and revenue sharing based on USDC balances on Coinbase and third-party distribution/usage. Coinbase's 2024 Form 10-K describes an initial three-year term.
coinbase_circle.xrpl: Circle's current USDC page lists XRPL among native USDC networks. USDC on XRPL is not XRP; stablecoin transfer growth must not be treated as XRP asset demand.

coinbase_ripple.relationship: Coinbase and Ripple announced an RLUSD distribution partnership on 2026-10-28. At launch RLUSD was available through Coinbase Prime, Exchange and retail app, with deposits/withdrawals across XRPL, Base and Ethereum and 1:1 USD conversion. Ripple said it would provide liquidity on Base.
coinbase_ripple.collateral_status: RLUSD collateral support for Coinbase Global Exchange customers was described as a future follow-on, not a live launch feature in the 2026-10-28 announcement. This differs from Ripple Prime, where Ripple says RLUSD is already used as collateral in some prime-brokerage products.
coinbase_ripple.xrp_caveat: This establishes RLUSD distribution, not XRP purchases, XRP collateral, or proof of XRP bridge-asset usage.

institutional_relationships.counter_hypothesis: Institutional stablecoin distribution, custody, prime brokerage and tokenized finance can grow through USDC, RLUSD, JPYSC, Circle Arc, bank deposits and Ripple Prime without creating proportional XRP spot demand. Even when RLUSD or USDC is used on XRPL, XRP demand must be measured separately through bridge-asset settlement, XRP-denominated collateral, liquidity depth, actual XRP balances and fees.

ripple_prime_and_bny.prime_brokerage: Ripple completed the Hidden Road acquisition on 2025-10-24 and renamed it Ripple Prime. Ripple says RLUSD is already collateral for a number of prime-brokerage products and some derivatives customers hold RLUSD balances. Its current product page lists RLUSD, XRP, tokenized real-world assets and traditional assets as collateral categories. These are product disclosures, not audited posted-collateral volumes.
ripple_prime_and_bny.specific_use: Ripple's 2026-10-15 RWA perpetual-swap launch says institutional clients including Virtu can cross-margin RWA swaps and use RLUSD as collateral. This is a stated live product offering; client-level collateral balances were not disclosed.
ripple_prime_and_bny.bny_custody: BNY was selected as primary reserve custodian for RLUSD in July 2025. On 2026-10-27 Ripple and BNY announced that BNY Digital Asset Custody now supports XRP and RLUSD for eligible institutional clients. They intend to enable direct RLUSD mint/redeem through BNY and explore tokenized trade finance on XRPL, subject to final approvals.
ripple_prime_and_bny.limits: BNY support is custody availability, not evidence of client XRP holdings or net inflows. Direct BNY mint/redeem and broader XRPL tokenized-asset support are stated future plans subject to approvals.

circle_arc.launch: Circle announced Arc mainnet on 2026-09-16. Circle describes Arc as an L1 for financial markets, real-time money movement and agentic economic activity, with USDC gas fees and more than 100 builders/validators at launch.
circle_arc.sbi_role: Circle's release quotes SBI Holdings CEO Yoshitaka Kitao describing SBI Group as a founding validator and saying SBI intends to use USDC and JPYSC, a trust-type yen stablecoin issued by SBI Shinsei Trust.
circle_arc.xrp_implication: This is a competing/parallel institutional settlement path that can operate without XRP as the bridge asset. It must be modeled as a counter-hypothesis to XRP adoption, not as positive XRP demand.

ripple_robinhood.announcement: Ripple and Robinhood announced a strategic partnership on 2026-10-27. RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood; in-app availability was stated as a later rollout. Robinhood plans to use RLUSD on XRPL for institutional settlement and Ripple Treasury for cash/liquidity operations. Ripple Prime already provides Bitstamp lending and margin financing across roughly 20 digital assets.
ripple_robinhood.caveat: This is a stablecoin, treasury and prime-brokerage integration; it is not proof of XRP bridge usage or XRP demand.

institutional_relationships.direct_circle_ripple_relationship: No direct bilateral Circle-Ripple partnership was established from the primary sources reviewed. Circle's USDC and Ripple's RLUSD are separate issuer products; both are available on XRPL. Their coexistence on XRPL is not proof of XRP bridge usage or demand.

ripple_corporate_scale.company_statement: Ripple's 2026-10-28 company release said it expected to exit 2026 at a $900M annualized product-revenue run rate, had enabled more than $16T of transactions across its products in 2025, held 85+ licenses, and served 1,700+ institutions/corporates/enterprises.
ripple_corporate_scale.model_caveat: These are Ripple corporate product metrics. They are not XRP Ledger transaction volume, XRP notional settlement, XRP sales, XRP holdings, or independent audit figures.

flow_reconciliation.interpretation: Do not average these values. They differ in issuer universe, publication cutoffs, partial-day completeness, flow-excluded fund treatment, units and source lineage. XRP Insights' positive two-day total conflicts with CryptoKeyhole's large partial Nov 16 outflow and Alpha Finance's Nov 17 USD outflow. Reconcile each issuer's dated holdings files and timestamps before model admission.

exact_phrase_research.ask_coin: Permission Coin (ASK) remains a plausible exact-name match; no primary-source XRP, XRPL or Ripple relationship was established.
exact_phrase_research.actual_capital: No new primary evidence establishes proprietary XRP purchases or verified net capital entering XRP. Commentary and securities disclosures must not be relabeled as XRP spot inflows.
exact_phrase_research.sbic_chatgpt: Official SBIC East/Central/West materials establish ChatGPT/AI seminars and training only; no OpenAI partnership, integration or affiliation was found.
exact_phrase_research.camilla_kamilah_stevenson: No additional video was promoted to verified inventory. The previously verified Paul Barron guest appearance is supported by publisher and iHeart episode records, but a self-authenticated channel ownership link remains unavailable. The separate 'I Moved My XRP Off The Exchanges' candidate channel remains unverified and excluded.

prediction.reason: No trained XRP-specific candidate has demonstrated leakage-safe out-of-sample superiority over all required baselines with calibrated probabilities, stable drift, independent shadow outcomes, source-clustered uncertainty intervals and independent Ed25519 attestation.

source_independence.primary_corporate_sources: SBI, Ripple, Coinbase, Circle and SBIC pages are primary for their own corporate disclosures but are not independent corroboration of each other's claims.
source_independence.market_sources: Kraken and OKX are separate venue observations. ETF aggregators may derive from overlapping issuer files and must not be counted as independent capital-flow sources.
source_independence.data_retention: Web-rendered API responses in this research artifact are not raw HTTP byte captures and have no raw-source SHA-256 receipt.

regulatory_disagreement.issue: Ripple National Trust Bank charter status
regulatory_disagreement.corporate_statement: Ripple's 2026-10-28 company release says it received final OCC approval for a National Trust Bank charter.
regulatory_disagreement.regulator_record: The OCC's public 2025-12-12 decision letter and published decisions index reviewed in this run show preliminary conditional approval; no final charter authorization or commencement-of-business decision was located in the OCC sources reviewed.
regulatory_disagreement.disposition: Unresolved source disagreement. Do not describe the charter as operational or the bank as open until the OCC's final approval/commencement authorization is independently located.

us_genius_rule.finding: OCC published its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act for payment stablecoin issuers and certain custody activities under OCC jurisdiction. The rule and GENIUS Act take effect 2027-01-18. OCC states that BSA/AML and OFAC-related requirements are to be addressed in separate rulemaking.
us_genius_rule.implication: Stablecoin issuer/custody compliance requirements are becoming more defined, but this does not establish XRP as a required settlement asset or determine the final status of Ripple National Trust Bank.
